$comment: T-2.44: sound recipes, rendered offline by `pnpm gen:audio` into client/public/audio/ (ADR-017). Each sound is layers of a source (noise, osc, impulse) through an envelope, filters, drive, a delay and a reverb, mixed and peak-normalised; `variants` seeded takes differ by `jitter`. `bounds` are what a render must measure — a test holds every committed render to them. One placeholder, the click, proves the path; the weapons (T-2.46) and the world (T-2.47) add theirs.
